title.narrative: number of teachers and training staff participating in the work place programme
A.E.3. Number of staff that have gained qualitative and relevant knowledge and skills to develop and offer the revised/developed study programmes

comment.narrative:
14-09-2022: Due to Corona only one technical and didactical training (digital training using Zoom) was conducted on Post Harvest lead by an expert of Inholland. The group of participants consisted of 3 participants per Kenyan institution (plus 2 additional). In order to keep the digital meetings active, the group size is limited. The participants are lecturers of the institutions and are now capable of developing training material and explain to other teachers/lecturers how to develop an interactive training/ class on Post harvest management for their students.
LMNA stocktaking was done at the beginning of the project. New LMNA’s to be conducted were not immediately necessary. However, the institutions indicated that they would need some capacity building training on a practical method for conducting a LMNA. The capacity building training is linked to the triple helix assessment because it is also related to mapping stakeholders and interviewing them. The ‘training’ has started in August this year with the same maximum 9 participants).

14-09-2022: • LMNA: Total 9: (6 M, 3 F) • Google forms: Total 11 (7 M, 4 F) • Gender: Total 20: (5 M, 15 F) • Post- harvest: Total 11 (5 M, 6 F) • PH Tomato: Total 14 (5 M, 9 F) • IPM: Total 10 (5 M, 5 F) • Career guidance: Total 10 (5 M and 5 F) • Blended learning, Total 8 (5 M and 3 F)

title.narrative: A.O.6. Number of facilities established/strengthened

comment.narrative: 10-10-2023: see earlier reports

14-09-2022: Beginning of 2021 a supplier has been selected to supply three greenhouses at each institution. The specification of the greenhouses were discussed and approved among the three institutions and includes an irrigation system.
Some ICt investments have also been done on connectivity and ICT equipment for all three organizations which contributes to the online project activities and online learning,

14-09-2022: Facility assessments have been conducted for each institution. This will lead to investment proposals for the missing facilities related to educational purposes: a greenhouse for teaching, post-harvest equipment etc. Already some quotes have been requested from suppliers to have an indication of the size of the investments related to the budget.
